description: Defines the RocketElement class, a custom UI element derived from Rml::Element, with methods for handling dimensions, rendering, updating, and event processing within the Unvanquished game engine's UI system.

classes.name: RocketElement
classes.description: A custom UI element class for rendering and interaction within the game's UI, extending Rml::Element.

methods.name: GetIntrinsicDimensions
methods.description: Calculates and sets the element's dimensions based on its width and height properties, considering absolute units and parent dimensions.

methods.name: ProcessDefaultAction
methods.description: Processes default events, pushing relevant events into the event queue, excluding mouse and resize events.

methods.name: OnRender
methods.description: Handles rendering of the element, including custom rendering via CG_Rocket_RenderElement.

methods.name: OnUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating of the element, including custom update logic via CG_Rocket_UpdateElement.
